seo.title: Product — LIKWIDMACK portfolio system
seo.description: Product presentation for the LIKWIDMACK portfolio: architecture diagram, codebase samples, and feature details with toast feedback.

hero.title: LIKWIDMACK portfolio system
hero.lede: A walkthrough of the creative-tech portfolio stack — Nuxt app, theme tokens, and PrimeVue UI — with sidebar navigation, toast feedback, and three ways to inspect the product.

overview.heading: What this product is
paragraphs: This portfolio is a Nuxt 4 application wired to a shared design system (`@tgmc/theme`), content collections, and PrimeVue wrappers. The presentation layer stays CUBE-oriented: composition layouts, utilities, blocks, and data-* exceptions.
Use the sidebar to jump sections. In Presentation, switch between Description, Diagram/UML, and Codebase views of the same product story.

presentation.heading: Inspect the product
presentation.lede: Choose how you want to read the system — narrative, structure, or source.

description.title: Product details
body: The web app owns routes, content queries, and Ui* wrappers. Theme owns tokens, SCSS layers, and PrimeVue preset mapping so surfaces stay contrast-safe across light and dark modes.
Page chrome uses a split layout: sticky AppPageNav on the rail and scrollable body sections. Toast feedback is mounted once in the site shell for copy actions and view changes.
bullets: Data-driven copy via Nuxt Content collections and Zod schemas
UiStack switches PrimeVue vs native fallbacks without page rewrites
Syntax-highlighted code frames for walkthrough samples
